metaDescription: Order custom 50 to 99 page stationery for bulk business use. Greeting cards, envelopes & more with your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: For bulk buyers who need a substantial but not oversized format, 50 to 99 page stationery hits the sweet spot: thick enough for multi-page mailers or premium greeting cards, yet compact enough for cost-effective shipping. Whether you're ordering branded holiday card sets like the Gold Star Tree Greeting Card or currency envelopes for incentive programs, this page count range gives you room for a personalized message without excess. Decorate with foil stamping or full-color print to make your logo stand out.
heroAltText: Custom 50 to 99 page stationery including greeting cards and envelopes with foil accents for business branding
